desc:
Welcome to Velocity Drift! 

⚠️ This game is in alpha. Expect bugs, and frequent updates will be released to improve the experience. Updates such as a dealership and car customization are being worked on.

Latest Update (24/03/2026)
• Added Nissan Silvia s14 Stock
• Added Ford Mustang Gt Coupe Stock
• Added Nissan Fairlady 240z Stock
• Added new map! Nikko Circuit


Velocity drift is a drifting game with a balance between realism and arcade styled handling! This game requires practice to become good at, so test out different cars and see if you can master them!

Join the communications server to stay up to date with the game!
Join the roblox group too!

⭐ Enjoy the game? Like & favorite the game!

🌐 Want to join a friend? Join through their profile!

Tags: Drift Drifting Drift Game Velocity Drift Car Game Cars JDM
